stories.title: Hegseth: "Si potrà seguire in diretta la fucilazione dell'autore della strage di Fort Hood nel 2009"

en.title: Hegseth: "The execution of the Fort Hood 2009 massacre perpetrator will be able to be followed live"
en.summary: The Pentagon chief announced that Nidal Malik Hasan, who killed 13 fellow soldiers at the Texas military base in 2009, will be the first person executed publicly in 90 years.

stories.title: Nobel per Pace a Navi PIllay: da bimba nel Sudafrica dell'Apartheid a giurista sulle macerie di Gaza

en.title: Peace Nobel Prize to Navi Pillay: from childhood in Apartheid South Africa to jurist amid Gaza's ruins
en.summary: Navi Pillay received the Peace Nobel Prize for her career spanning from poverty-stricken childhood to serving in international criminal tribunals.

stories.title: Maltempo al Sud. Doppia tromba d'aria a Marsala, alberi caduti a Napoli

en.title: Bad weather in the South. Double waterspout in Marsala, fallen trees in Naples
en.summary: Severe weather struck southern Italy with waterspouts in Marsala and downed trees in Naples, while rainy conditions are expected to continue through the weekend across the country.

stories.title: “Ma è vero?”: Navi Pillay sorpresa dal Nobel per la Pace, poi gli applausi e la battuta su Trump

en.title: "Is it true?": Navi Pillay surprised by Nobel Peace Prize, then applause and a joke about Trump
en.summary: South African jurist Navi Pillay, 85, received the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her work on peace and international law, jokingly suggesting she might share the award with Trump.

stories.title: Il premio Nobel per la Pace Navi Pillay: "Serve sostegno internazionale ai diritti dei palestinesi"

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize Winner Navi Pillay: "International Support for Palestinian Rights is Needed"
en.summary: Judge Navi Pillay, the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize recipient, discussed Palestinian rights in an interview with RaiNews24 following her leadership of a UN commission investigating events in Gaza.

stories.title: Le prime parole della Nobel per la Pace: “A Gaza è un genocidio, serve coraggio per dire la verità?”

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize Winner's First Words: "Gaza is Genocide, Courage is Needed to Tell the Truth"
en.summary: Navi Pillay learned of her 2026 Nobel Peace Prize win while attending a conference on international law in Nuremberg, describing her Gaza investigation as an impartial assessment based on facts.

stories.title: Le impressionanti immagini della doppia tromba marina a Marsala: auto capovolte e feriti

en.title: Striking Images of Dual Waterspout in Marsala: Overturned Cars and Injuries
en.summary: A double waterspout caused significant damage in Marsala, overturning vehicles and injuring people, with a school also severely damaged.

stories.title: Premio Nobel per la Pace 2026 alla giudice Navi Pillay. Sanzioni Usa alla Cpi

en.title: Judge Navi Pillay Wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize; US Sanctions Against ICC
en.summary: Judge Navi Pillay received the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for courage and integrity against war crimes, announced at the Nobel Institute in Oslo. Israel criticized the award while Pillay joked about sharing it with Trump.

stories.title: Perché il Nobel per la pace a Navi Pillay è un messaggio a Netanyahu / Video

en.title: Why the Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay is a message to Netanyahu
en.summary: South African jurist Navi Pillay, who led a UN commission that accused Israel of genocide, has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: La devastazione della doppia tromba marina a Marsala: auto ribaltate e feriti

en.title: Destruction caused by double waterspout in Marsala: overturned cars and injuries
en.summary: A double waterspout struck the port area of Marsala in Sicily, causing damage to buildings, vehicles and crops, with reported injuries.

stories.title: Nobel per la pace alla sudafricana Navi Pillay: “Genocidio a Gaza”. Israele: Goebbels applaudirebbe

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African Navi Pillay: "Genocide in Gaza". Israel: Goebbels would applaud
en.summary: The Nobel Peace Prize committee recognized Navi Pillay's role in ensuring war crimes and genocide are prosecuted internationally, triggering criticism from Israel and others.

stories.title: La fucilazione dell'autore della strage di Fort Hood sarà in streaming. Onu: “Forma di tortura”

en.title: Execution of Fort Hood shooting perpetrator to be livestreamed. UN: "Form of torture"
en.summary: Nidal Malik Hasan is scheduled to be executed on December 3, with the proceeding to be broadcast online, drawing criticism from the United Nations.

stories.title: Equo compenso, il Tar respinge il ricorso di Meta

en.title: Fair compensation, the TAR rejects Meta's appeal
en.summary: Meta lost a case at the Lazio Administrative Court regarding fair compensation for news content. Publishers are calling for concrete implementation of the right to be paid when their news is used online.

stories.title: Esaote diventa cinese: Midea proprietaria al 100%

en.title: Esaote becomes Chinese: Midea is 100% owner
en.summary: Chinese group Midea has completed the acquisition of 100% of Esaote, an Italian medical imaging company headquartered in Genoa with operations in Florence.

stories.title: Giù la produzione industriale (-1,3%), frenata da moda e chimica

en.title: Industrial production down (-1.3%), slowed by fashion and chemicals
en.summary: Italy's industrial production declined 1.3% in August according to Istat data, with no annual variation, returning to levels from a year earlier.

stories.title: Data center, in Italia investimenti potenziali per 37 miliardi di euro

en.title: Data centers, potential investments of 37 billion euros in Italy
en.summary: Italy's data center sector could attract 37 billion euros in potential investments driven by artificial intelligence demand, though operators cite regulatory certainty as a key obstacle.

stories.title: Ansaldo energia incorpora Nucleare come business unit

en.title: Ansaldo Energia incorporates Nuclear as business unit
en.summary: Ansaldo Energia's board approved the merger of Ansaldo Nucleare through incorporation, creating a dedicated Nuclear business unit within the company.
